title: SimWorld world profile
description: SimWorld world profile: every tuning value of the streamed world. All keys are optional in a file or in `profile_overrides` (omitted keys keep the defaults; objects merge deeply, arrays and scalars replace). Structural values (4 bands over zooms 13-16, layer names) are not tunable. Defaults = addons/simworld/profiles/default.json = the compiled-in defaults.

profile_version.description: Profile schema version (integer). A file with the library's version or older is strict (an unknown key is an error); a newer file loads and unknown keys are ignored with a warning. The library reads version 2 (version 2 added buildings.r0..r2.min_height_m; a version 1 file loads with their defaults).

bands.description: LOD bands as a quadtree cover by 3D slant distance (camera to the nearest point of a tile's box). R0 = z16 ... R3 = z13.

r0_edge_m.description: Outer slant-distance edge of R0 (z16, full extrusion), meters. Must be below r1_edge_m.

r1_edge_m.description: Outer slant-distance edge of R1 (z15), meters. Must be below r2_edge_m.

r2_edge_m.description: Outer slant-distance edge of R2 (z14), meters. Must be below r3_edge_m.

r3_edge_m.description: Outer slant-distance edge of R3 (z13, light points only) and of the whole cover, meters. Nothing is requested beyond it (times hysteresis for tiles already in).

hysteresis.description: Factor: a tile changes band only once its slant distance is this far past the band edge (1.15 = 15 %). The gap edge x (hysteresis - 1) also drives the dithered LOD fade.

look_ahead_s.description: Look-ahead horizon, seconds: each band's view point is camera + velocity x this (vertical speed included).

look_ahead_clamp.description: Look-ahead offset clamp as a fraction of the band's edge (0.5 = half the band radius).

default_tile_height_m.description: Box height (meters) assumed for a tile whose own and ancestors' building heights are not known yet.

buildings.description: Building meshing per band (R3 has no buildings).

r0.description: Building meshing at R0 (z16, nearest band).

min_area_m2.description: Drop buildings whose footprint is smaller, square meters (0 = keep all).

min_height_m.description: Drop buildings whose resolved roof height is lower, meters above ground (tagged height, else levels x floor height, else the kind/landuse fallback; per feature, like min_area_m2; 0 = keep all; profile_version 2). Building mesh only: lights, ground and roads are unaffected.

min_area_m2.description: Drop buildings whose footprint is smaller, square meters (0 = keep all).

min_height_m.description: Drop buildings whose resolved roof height is lower, meters above ground (tagged height, else levels x floor height, else the kind/landuse fallback; per feature, like min_area_m2; 0 = keep all; profile_version 2). Building mesh only: lights, ground and roads are unaffected.

min_height_m.description: Drop buildings whose resolved roof height is lower, meters above ground (tagged height, else levels x floor height, else the kind/landuse fallback; per feature, like min_area_m2; 0 = keep all; profile_version 2). Building mesh only: lights, ground and roads are unaffected.

ground.description: Ground meshing (landuse areas and road strips) per band, road classes and widths, area classes and stacking levels. R3 has no ground.

r0.description: Ground meshing at R0 (z16, nearest band).

area_dp_m.description: Douglas-Peucker tolerance for area outlines, meters.

min_area_m2.description: Drop areas smaller than this, square meters (0 = keep all).

road_dp_m.description: Douglas-Peucker tolerance for road centerlines, meters.

max_road_class.description: Keep roads of this class and every more important one (other = all roads).

lift_step_m.description: Vertical lift per stacking level, meters (against z-fighting; level up to 13 for roads).

roads.description: Road classes (contract ground COLOR b = class / 8: 1 motorway, 2 primary, 3 secondary, 4 tertiary, 5 residential, 6 other) and full strip widths.

other_width_m.description: Full strip width (meters) of class 6: every highway value not listed in another class (service, pedestrian, footway, path, ...).

link_width_factor.description: `_link` roads keep their class at this fraction of its width, rounded to 0.1 m.

link_min_width_m.description: Minimum full width (meters) of a `_link` road.

minor_paths.description: Class-6 highway values that count as minor paths: kept at R0 only (ground.r1/r2 minor_paths = false drops them).

lit_values.description: OSM `lit` values (trimmed) that mark a road as lit (ground COLOR g = 1).

areas.description: Area groups by free name: each maps `landuse` layer kinds to a ground class and a stacking level. Add a group to classify more kinds; a kind may appear in one group only.

class.description: Ground class (contract ground COLOR r = id / 16): grass 0, forest 1, water 2, residential 3, commercial 4, industrial 5, other 6.

level.description: Stacking level against z-fighting, 0..7 (higher draws on top; roads use 8..13). Lift = level x the band's lift_step_m.

other_area_level.description: Stacking level of landuse kinds listed in no group (class other).

lights.description: Light sprites (R2/R3) and building light profiles.

cluster_on_agl_m.description: Above this height above ground (meters) each tile's lights are clustered into cells (the light carpet); already delivered R2/R3 tiles are re-delivered.

cluster_off_agl_m.description: Below this height above ground (meters) clustering switches off again (hysteresis). Must not exceed cluster_on_agl_m.

cluster_cell_m.description: Cell size (meters) of the clustered light carpet.

profiles.description: Light profiles (contract vertex COLOR r = id / 8: residential 0, office 1, retail 2, industrial 3, civic 4): which OSM building values belong to each, and the sprite color.

kinds.description: OSM `building` values of this profile (a value may appear in one profile only).

landuse_fallback.description: Profile of buildings whose kind is in no profile, by the landuse polygon around them.

industrial.description: Profile for landuse industrial (and railway, port, depot, garages, quarry).

civic.description: Profile for landuse religious, education, institutional, civic, military.

none.description: Profile when no landuse polygon contains the building.

max_fetch_per_band.description: Tile fetches in flight per band (count).

max_mesh_per_band.description: Decode and mesh jobs in flight per band (count).

redeliveries_per_frame.description: Light-mode re-deliveries handed out per frame (count).

retry_base_s.description: Retry backoff after a failed fetch or decode: first wait, seconds; doubled per attempt (at most 64x).

retry_max_s.description: Retry backoff cap, seconds. Must not be below retry_base_s.

cap_s.description: Safety cap, seconds: a LOD fade is force-completed this long after it started (default 0.75; also bounds how long a stationary camera waits for a frozen fade before the next finer ring may refine).

recenter_distance_m.description: Re-center the floating origin when the camera is farther than this (meters, horizontal) from it.

cap_mb.description: Disk cache LRU cap, MiB (raw tile bytes; meshes are never cached).

open_retry_s.description: Minimum wait (seconds) before re-opening an archive that failed to open.

validate_retry_s.description: While the archive is unreachable, re-validate the disk cache against it this often (seconds).
